# Reachable vulnerabilities that CI is allowed to see (see the `security` job in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml). Anything NOT listed here fails the build, so this
# file is the record of what we knowingly ship with — keep it short and dated.
#
# Look an ID up at https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/<ID>.
#
# Every entry below is transitive: nelm and sops pull in the docker/containerd
# stack for OCI chart access, and none of it is reachable from a code path
# nelmwave exposes on its own. They are still listed one by one rather than
# waved away with a module-wide rule, so a *new* CVE in the same module is a
# build failure, not a silent addition.
#
# Recorded 2026-08-05 against the dependency set in go.mod. Re-check after any
# nelm, sops or docker/cli bump: the shortest way to shorten this list is to
# drop the entries that stop being reachable.

# github.com/containerd/containerd — dragged in by nelm's OCI registry client.
# Fixing these needs a containerd bump, which is gated on the docker/cli v25
# `replace` pin in go.mod (oras-go vs sops conflict, see the comment there).
GO-2025-3528
GO-2025-4100
GO-2025-4108
GO-2026-5064
GO-2026-5338
GO-2026-5475
GO-2026-5622
GO-2026-5758

# github.com/docker/docker — same story: pulled in behind the docker/cli pin.
GO-2025-3829
GO-2026-4883
GO-2026-4887
GO-2026-5668

# golang.org/x/crypto — this one is probably a plain `go get -u
# golang.org/x/crypto` away from being fixed. Do that and delete this line
# rather than letting it sit here.
GO-2026-5932
